body.name: Exact source-aware terminal subroutine \(\mathsf{SATerm}\)
body.construction: Input is the reached terminal's ordered original-cycle label, boundary rows, \(S,\operatorname{inc},\Omega,\mathcal L,\Phi,H,K\). First enumerate source tuples lexicographically and form the exact polynomials \(\pi_t(\theta)=\sum_{u:g(u)=t}\prod_s\lambda_{s,u_s}\), retaining one simplex block per named source. Use real quantifier elimination on two disjoint copies \(\theta^-,\theta^+\) to decide the formula \(\Phi(\theta^-)=\Phi(\theta^+), K(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)>0, H(\theta^-)K(\theta^+)-H(\theta^+)K(\theta^-)\ne0\), together with legality and every boundary-interface equality. If satisfiable, select the lexicographically first cylindrical algebraic sample cell and emit its minimal polynomials, isolating rational intervals, signs, decoded source tables, and cross-product as \(\Gamma\). If unsatisfiable, compute the lexicographically ordered comprehensive Groebner decomposition of the legal source ideal over \(\mathbb Q[p]\); on every positive component, perform exact function-field membership for \(H/K\), combine equal representatives, and verify the candidate \(C=N/D\) by quantifier elimination of \(K>0\) and \(D(\Phi)H-N(\Phi)K\ne0\) or \(D(\Phi)=0\). Emit \(C\) exactly when both formulas are unsatisfiable. If the separator formula is unsatisfiable but membership or cross-component agreement fails, emit the exact component record \(O\). No unrestricted response-profile simplex, district-level latent consolidation, or row-span substitution occurs.
